none: PAS DENO-7795DD: Roman coin: siliqua of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A clipped silver Roman siliqua of the House of Valentinian (AD 364-378), dating to the period AD 364-378 (Reece Period 19). Wreath inscribed VOT / X / MVLT / XX reverse type. Moorhead (A History of Roman Coinage in Britain, p200) suggests that heavy clipping of this nature took place in the 5th Century, possibly with local official sanction to ease the shortage of silver.
